name: The Bloodline Keep
realm: Portraits of ancestors watch you. Their powers are yours to inherit.
lesson: Inheritance lets a class build on another: class Dog : public Animal. Mark a base function virtual and derived classes can override it; calling through a base pointer or reference then runs the DERIVED version (polymorphism). Add override so the compiler checks you, and give polymorphic bases a virtual destructor.

trial.prompt: Which syntax makes Dog inherit publicly from Animal?
Which keyword lets derived classes override a function at runtime?

trial.hint: The real object is a B.
trial.explain: Virtual call picks the derived override.

options: a) asks the compiler to check you really override a virtual
trial.explain: A typo'd signature becomes a compile error.

trial.prompt: Now A::name is NOT virtual. What prints?
trial.explain: Without virtual the static type decides.

boss.prompt: Why give a polymorphic base class a virtual destructor?
options: a) deleting via a base pointer then destroys the derived part too
boss.explain: Otherwise only the base destructor runs - undefined behavior.

boss.prompt: A class with a pure virtual function (= 0) is called…? (one word)

boss.explain: The override runs through the reference.

spell.prompt: Write class Dog that publicly derives from Animal and overrides speak() to return "Woof".
spell.hint: class Dog : public Animal { public: string speak() const override { return "Woof"; } };
